# Project name

Explain the problem, intended user, and what the project does in two or three sentences.

## Current state

Describe what works today, how it was verified, and what is not available yet. Link to tests, releases, or evidence. Do not imply deployment just because code exists.

## Quick start

List prerequisites, installation, local run, and meaningful test commands. Show configuration names with placeholder values only.

## Documentation

Link to the architecture, setup, operations, decisions, and history that actually exist. Add files when they are useful; do not maintain empty sections.
